summary: The benchmarks remain firmly higher on IT, but the rally is narrow: midcaps and smallcaps are slightly negative and more sectors are falling than rising.

detail.tone: Gains look less broad than at 10:30: later snapshots put the Sensex up roughly 360–600 points, versus the ~900-point high, as the Nifty MidCap and SmallCap slipped 0.11% and 0.41%.
